title: Best Refurbished iPhones Under $400 in the USA (2026)
content_html:
Looking for an iPhone without paying full retail price? This guide highlights refurbished iPhones worth checking when your budget is under $400, with a focus on value, age, everyday usability and long-term usefulness.

The links below take you to current eBay.com search results so you can compare live prices, condition and seller feedback before buying.

Some links in this article are affiliate links. We may earn a commission if you make a purchase.

1. iPhone 14 - best all-round choice

The iPhone 14 is one of the first models we would check at this budget. It offers 5G, strong cameras and a modern design, while refurbished pricing can be far lower than buying new.

Best for: buyers who want a relatively recent iPhone and are comfortable spending toward the top of the $400 budget.

Check current refurbished iPhone 14 listings on eBay

2. iPhone 13 Pro - best premium option

The iPhone 13 Pro is a great model to watch if you want ProMotion, a premium build and a more advanced camera system without paying current flagship prices.

Best for: buyers who value display quality and camera features more than having the newest model number.

Check current refurbished iPhone 13 Pro listings on eBay

3. iPhone 13 - best balance of price and age

The standard iPhone 13 remains one of the easiest refurbished iPhones to recommend. It still feels modern, supports 5G and usually costs meaningfully less than newer models.

Best for: buyers who want a modern-feeling iPhone while keeping more of the budget in their pocket.

Check current refurbished iPhone 13 listings on eBay

4. iPhone 12 Pro - best lower-cost Pro model

The iPhone 12 Pro can still make sense if you want a premium design and triple-camera setup for less. Because it is older, battery condition becomes especially important.

Best for: buyers looking for Pro features at a lower refurbished price.

Check current refurbished iPhone 12 Pro listings on eBay

5. iPhone SE 2022 - best budget option

The third-generation iPhone SE is the cheapest route into a relatively recent iPhone. It keeps Touch ID and the traditional Home button while offering capable performance for everyday use.

Best for: first phones, light users and anyone who prefers a smaller device with Touch ID.

Check current refurbished iPhone SE 2022 listings on eBay

What should you check before buying?

Check whether the phone is unlocked, its storage capacity, cosmetic condition, seller feedback, returns policy and warranty. Battery health is especially important on older iPhones, so look for clear battery information where the seller provides it.

Our pick

For most buyers, the iPhone 14 and iPhone 13 are the first models we would compare. If an iPhone 13 Pro falls within budget from a reputable seller, it can also be an excellent value choice.

Guide updated September 2026. Prices, promotions, availability and condition change regularly, so always check the live listing before purchasing.
